question: When does descent of power occur according to the knowledge teacher?
premises: The knowledge teacher speaks of proof and praise.
Descent of power is accepted by those who conceal.
inference: Descent occurs at destruction of dharma-adharma pervasion.
plain_english: The glorious knowledge teacher said: in view of proof and praise, at the time of destruction of dharma-adharma pervasion, descent of power is accepted by those who conceal.
